subject: Re: Redwood Inference + StellarApps — EoQ re-engage and legal timing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Gupta <pgupta@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Inference — post-demo recap & next steps

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — Jordan and I appreciated the deep dive into StellarApps' recommendation pipeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- What we heard: 500-1,000 concurrent inference requests at 150-300 tokens per request, strict PII controls, and a strong need for predictable latency (<200ms p95) for web endpoints.
- Our recommendation: start with a Dedicated pilot for 2 months (reserved pool + prefix caching) to validate latency and cost, then roll to production on the same model variant.

Mutual action plan:
1) Redwood: share SOW + estimated run-rate and example config (attached).
2) StellarApps: confirm procurement timeline + required security docs (SOC 2, subprocessor list).
3) Technical sync: schedule a 30-min infra call with your infra lead to confirm network/KMS requirements.

Attached: SOW-starter.pdf (proposal stub).

Ask: can you confirm whether budget/approval will be in place by the end of this quarter (June 30)? That timing helps us prioritize capacity for a July kickoff. If not, let me know expected approval window and any blockers we can help unblock.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Hi Priya — quick end-of-quarter check.

We know timelines can shift at EoQ — is StellarApps still planning to move forward on the Dedicated pilot with approval by today/tomorrow? If the budget or priority slipped, totally understand — if that's the case, could you share the new expected approval window?

If it helps, we can:
- Hold the pilot slot through mid-July without charging committed usage,
- Offer a short-term pilot pricing credit to help close approvals, or
- Fast-track the legal review with a slim SOW to remove blockers.

No pressure — just want to make sure we're aligned and not blocking your team.
